identity_and_freshness.basis: Request, corpus, current interop identity, actual Artifact, and frozen expected identity are hash-bound.

decidability.basis: The direction claim is decidable by one acceptable current full method identity and explicit forbidden identities.

source_coverage.basis: The expected record binds current API/IL plus bounded Runtime support, but the evaluated actual completed only two of three planned lanes.

expected_grounding.basis: The expected direction is current-identity-bound but reference-assisted and carries bounded historical/Runtime support.

expected_actual_isolation.basis: The actual was committed without annotation/Golden input and was rebound before expected-side comparison.

comparator_validity.basis: The full-identity direction check distinguishes this failure, while narrative relation requirements remain unscored.

discriminative_power.basis: The missing acceptable identity is a meaningful direction failure; sufficiency/control diagnostics alone are not decisive.

feasible_reference_path.basis: The ideal three searches, one relevant IL inspection, and one finish fit exactly within five model steps and four tool calls, with no scheduling margin.

limitations: calibration-informed and reference-assisted, not blind or held-out
narrative relation fields are not scored by the generic comparator

claim_boundary.trace_eval_scope: one quick reliability audit over frozen assets; not the complete Trace/Eval engineering area
